name: Open source Yocto firmware for the Sovol SV08 3D printer

mentions.name: Open source Yocto firmware for the Sovol SV08 3D printer
mentions.description: A clean, Yocto-based open source system image for the Sovol SV08 3D printer, rebuilt from other sources to replace the vendor's GPL-violating binaries that ship without source code. The implementation is designed so support can be added for similar 3D printers.
mentions.problem: The Sovol SV08 ships with open source binaries but no source code, and the vendor is known to be violating the GPL.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently bought a Sovol SV08 printer.  It comes with open source binaries, but there is no source code.  Turns out they are a known to be violating the GPL.  Looks like it can be rebuilt from other sources, so I have started to put together a clean implementation using Yocto. It will be possible to add support for similar 3D printers.
mentions.author: voakbasda
